dossier.scp_unleashed.148.title: The Telekill Alloy
dossier.scp_unleashed.148.caption: SCP-148 at intake: part of the recovered stock, with one cast block.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-148 is kept as ingots in a standard storage container, or cast into blocks and set into the walls of cells that hold anomalies of a certain kind. Cast blocks are not to be moved without the approval of the cell's lead researcher.
No further SCP-148 can be produced. Every ingot is logged. **Recasting is permitted. Waste is not.**

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-148 is a dense metal alloy, deep green, with the lustre of polished jade. Under strong light a faint shimmer moves through it.

SCP-148 is opaque to anomalous influence that acts directly on the mind. Personnel near a cast block report that voices, urges and pulls of anomalous origin fall silent, while their own thoughts carry on as normal. The effect passes through walls and floors.
A helmet of SCP-148 gives the same protection to its wearer alone, wherever they go. SCP-148 offers no protection against physical harm, or against hazards that work through the eyes.

page.title: Addendum 148-1: Test Log
text: Test 148-02: a D-Class subject was held near a cast block with an anomaly known to call its victims to it. The subject reported hearing nothing at all and asked to return to the canteen.
Test 148-04: the block was removed. %rThe subject did not ask to go anywhere after that.%r
Test 148-06: a researcher wearing the helmet entered the same cell. The researcher was unaffected. The D-Class standing beside the researcher was not.

page.title: Addendum 148-2: Provenance
page.text: SCP-148 has no recovery record. Twenty-seven ingots were handed to a reader of this file by the individual in Foundation dress described in the files of other objects, who said only that there would be no more. See field notes.

item.scp_unleashed.scp148_ingot.tooltip: A bar of green alloy, smooth and cool as polished jade.
item.scp_unleashed.scp148_ingot.details: Something stirs deep inside it when the light catches it. It is heavier than it looks.
item.scp_unleashed.scp148_ingot.supply: Nobody makes more of it. Spend it carefully.
block.scp_unleashed.scp148_block.tooltip: Telekill alloy cast into a block. It hums when someone stands close.
block.scp_unleashed.scp148_block.details: Near it, a mind is left to itself. Whatever reaches into heads from outside finds nothing to hold.
block.scp_unleashed.scp148_block.contain: One block quiets a whole room. A helmet quiets one head.
item.scp_unleashed.scp148_helmet.tooltip: A helmet beaten from telekill alloy.
item.scp_unleashed.scp148_helmet.details: Keeps the wearer's thoughts their own, wherever they walk.
item.scp_unleashed.scp148_helmet.alone: It guards one head. The people beside you are on their own.
jade.scp_unleashed.scp148_block.quiet: Your thoughts are very quiet here
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp148_ingot.1: SCP-148, the telekill alloy: a jade-green metal of unknown make. It is opaque to influences that reach into the mind, and to nothing else.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp148_ingot.2: Nine ingots cast a telekill block, and a block breaks back down into nine. Five ingots worked into a helmet shield whoever wears it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp148_ingot.3: It cannot be smelted, mined or bought. Recover the SCP-148 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal; a stranger in Foundation dress hands over enough for three blocks, and never any more.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp148_block.1: A block of telekill alloy. Once placed, it quiets the space around it: people close by are left alone by things that would reach into their heads.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp148_block.2: The quiet reaches every person near the block, in every direction, through walls and floors. The block hums softly when someone stands close.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp148_block.3: The best use of the alloy for containment: one block protects everyone near it. It does nothing against claws, teeth, or anything that works through the eyes.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp148_helmet.1: A helmet worked from five telekill ingots. Against blows it is about as good as iron, but it lasts as long as netherite.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp148_helmet.2: Whoever wears it keeps their thoughts their own, wherever they go. It protects the wearer and nobody else.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp148_helmet.3: Every helmet spends ingots that could have been a block. To guard a cell full of people, a block is the better use of the alloy.

archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp148.0: The courier hands over the alloy in person.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp148.1: Cast into blocks, it quiets a cell.
block.scp_unleashed.scp148_semantic_bloc: A telekill core in a coil cage. On the grid, its quiet carries much farther than bare alloy.
Built around a whole block of telekill alloy. Near it, a mind is left to itself.
Shields people within %s blocks while powered
Power it through an outlet on any face
Short of power it goes dark and shields nobody.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp148_semantic_b: A machine built around a whole block of telekill alloy. Fed from the wire network, it drives the alloy hard enough to quiet far more space than the bare block does.
While it receives its full %s SP/t, every person within %s blocks is shielded just as if they stood beside a telekill block. Short of power, it goes dark and shields nobody.
Building one spends a telekill block for good, and nobody makes more of the alloy. Choose carefully where it stands, and keep it fed.
